# infoblox_join_token (Resource)

Manages an Infoblox JoinToken in the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
resource "infoblox_join_token" "example" {
  uddi = {
    name = "example_join_token"

    // Other optional fields
    description = "Join token for Site A"
    tags = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi))
- `update_trigger` (String) An arbitrary value used to trigger an update. Not sent to the API. Change it when Terraform reports no infrastructure changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uddi`

Required:

- `name` (String) User-provided name for the join token.

Optional:

- `description` (String) User-provided description for the join token.
- `expires_at` (String) Timestamp after which the join token cannot be used, in RFC3339 format.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags associated with the join token. For valid values, see {tags:values}.

Read-Only:

- `join_token` (String, Sensitive) The actual join token secret. Returned only on create; never surfaced again by the API.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
- `token_id` (String) First half of the token, usable to identify the token in logs.
